title: Chapter 281 Lowering The Realm
content:
Chapter 281 Lowering The Realm

Feeling the throbbing of blood in his body, Ye Yan's face changed slightly, and then he showed a faint smile.

"It's been a long time since I met such a quality opponent."

"If you enter the Immortal Emperor Realm, you may really be able to pose a threat to me."

Ye Yan spoke slowly, his words full of confidence in his strength.

Immediately, a breath of the Immortal Emperor Realm overflowed from Ye Yan's body.

Feeling this aura, Qin Feng and the others changed their faces.

Immortal Emperor Realm!

Although it is only the early stage, it is also extremely terrifying.

Sure enough, all the monsters on the monster list have the strength of the Immortal Emperor realm.

In other words, the Immortal Emperor Realm is the lowest threshold for the evil list.

In this case, will Ao Qing still have a chance of winning?

The two turned to look at Ao Qing, and saw that Ao Qing looked calm and did not take Ye Yan, who was at the Immortal Emperor realm seriously.

"Is the Immortal Emperor Realm very amazing?"

At this moment, although Ao Qing was in the early stage of the Immortal Saint Realm, it was a completely different level than the Immortal Emperor Realm, Ao Qing's aura was not reduced at all.

"You really want to touch me?"

Seeing Ao Qing not seemingly joking, Ye Yan said immediately.

Upon hearing this, Ao Qing snorted and said, "What, don't you dare?"

Seeing this, Ye Yan nodded, "Okay, then I will descend to a certain level to fight you."

As soon as he finished speaking, Ye Yan's breath suddenly began to diminish sharply.

It was not until the early stage of the Immortal Saint Realm that it was almost over.

At the same time, three flames floating around Ye Yan also extinguished one.

As can be seen from the naked eye, Ye Yan's strength has declined a lot.

Seeing this scene, Qin Feng and Xiao Luo looked at each other, their eyes full of longing.

He is worthy of being a peerless monster on the list of monsters, and he really has his own arrogance.

Ao Qing looked at Ye Yan, who had his own cultivation level, and said nothing, but just smiled.

Pretend, pretend.

I'll regret it later.

Although Ao Qing said it very crazy, if you really want to fight, Ao Qing was not sure about Ye Yan at the Immortal Emperor realm.

After all, no one on the monster list can challenge the above level.

But now, the two of them are standing at the same height.

At this moment, Ao Qing had already imagined the scene of Ye Yan being beaten by him in his heart.

I really think I am just an ordinary nine-clawed dragon. I was promoted by my master himself, and the enhanced version of the nine-clawed dragon!

Buzz —

At this moment, the space beside me trembled.

The next moment, an old man in a civilian slowly walked out of the crack in the space.

"Huh? Who are you?"

When Xiao Luo saw the old man in a common man, he looked puzzled.

Qin Feng didn't recognize him, but he just felt that he looked familiar.

Just when everyone was confused, Ye Yan slowly stepped forward and bowed slightly, "Ye Yan has met the dean."

"Dean?!"

At the same time, a loud laugh came from the void.

Suddenly, the temperature in the field rose sharply.

A middle-aged man dressed in mentor's costume appeared in the field.

Li Changqing, the instructor of the inner courtyard, and the master of Huoyun Peak.

Similarly, he is also Ye Yan’s teacher.

"I didn't expect that it was you boy who came back first."

Li Changqing looked at Ye Yan and laughed.

Hearing this, Ye Yan smiled slightly, "The students have been practicing outside for many years, and naturally miss the academy and the teachers, so they speed up their pace."

"Hahaha, OK, OK."

At this moment, Li Changqing was already smiling from ear to ear.

Ye Yan is his most proud disciple, and he has been talking about it all year round.

He also had high hopes for Ye Yan.

Later, Ye Yan did not disappoint him and directly made it to the list of monsters. Until now, he is still on the list.

There are many people who can make it to the list of monsters, but those who can maintain it on it are truly qualified to be called monsters.

"Hey, are you saying enough?"

At this time, Ao Qing said a little unhappy.

It's all about to start, you're going to have the whole support, right?

If the conditions were not allowed, I would just call the entire wasteland city.

After all, Lu Daosheng is also his master.

When pets are in trouble, as owners, they should not sit idly by.

Of course, if Lu Xue calls him, it goes without saying.

It depends on whether Lu Xue is willing or not.

At this time, the academy president An Lingyun and Li Changqing also noticed Ao Qing.

The two looked at Ao Qing for a long time, with complex expressions in their eyes.

Once an eight-clawed dragon appeared in the fairy world, which was overwhelming the sky, and it made all the strong men of that era have a shadow.

It also dominated the entire fairy world of that era and created a glorious demon court.

However, with the departure of the eight-clawed dragon senior, the demon court never had such a stunning and beautiful demon clan. Without the leader, the demon court quickly declined and eventually disappeared from the fairy world. In the long river of history.

But the powerful people in the fairy world still remember the terrifying strength of the Eight-Clawed Divine Dragon.

Now, the nine-clawed extreme dragon, which is even more terrifying than the eight-clawed divine dragon, has appeared in their Tiandi Academy.

As long as Ao Qing doesn't have any surprises, he will definitely become the top strongest person in the fairy world in the future.

But the two of them were a little worried about Ao Qing's position.

Because strictly speaking, Ao Qing is not a student of their academy.

Just followed Lu Xue.

"Don't worry, don't worry, if you want to challenge Ye Yan, then of course you can."

The dean of the academy smiled.

To Ao Qing, he naturally had to show his kindness.

It’s not only because of Ao Qing, but also because of Lu Xue.

From the words of Qiao Danyang and Tan Songci, and even Xiao Yin, he had a rough understanding of the forces behind Lu Xue.

It's so scary.

Some of them are not even like the forces in the fairy world.

No wonder he could not see any causal aura in Lu Xue, probably because he was covered up by the strong man behind him.

So, he is naturally better for Lu Xue and Ao Qing.

"You two are both extraordinary in strength. If you fight here, the entire square will not be overturned by you."

The dean of the academy shook his head slightly, then waved his hand.

A huge barrier appeared in the void.

"Go, I'll take care of everything."

Upon hearing this, Ao Qing didn't say much, but jumped into the air.

At the same time, Ao Qing's body also skyrocketed, and in a blink of an eye he returned to his original body shape.

The huge dragon body stretches for millions of miles, covering the sky and the sun, and the void keeps trembling, as if it can't bear Ao Qing's body.

The terrifying dragon power also poured down.

Even with the barrier blocking performed by the dean of the academy, it still makes people feel heartbroken.

Of course, this movement undoubtedly attracted all the students in the college's inner courtyard.

"Then, that's that nine-clawed extreme dragon!"

"Go and have a look!"

In the square, Ye Yan looked at Ao Qing in the void and his face changed slightly.

He was not even as big as Ao Qing's eyes in front of him.

He suspected that Ao Qing did it on purpose.

"Teacher, Dean, Ye Yan is gone."

Ye Yan bowed to the two of them, and then slowly walked away from the barrier in the void.
